tool_args.rationale: All five pilot observations are positive and have H ≤ 0.48. The H≈20 probe directly tests whether slow adaptation reverses the response near the H=22.4 forecast horizon and helps separate its amplitude from its timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, slow adaptation constrains mostly the ratio of amplitude to timescale. Different parameter pairs can fit the pilot rows yet give different forecasts at H=22.4.
Finer sampling does not substitute for observing the slow response near the forecast horizon.
The auxiliary measurement does not constrain the slow adaptation term.
